_: Editor's log of the phone footage (data/videos), from contact sheets of every clip. `use`: usable [in, out] seconds. `sightings`: a rider passing the camera at clip second `at`, identified by the order and spacing of summit arrivals against race.json and confirmed by the riders' FIT tracks (tracks.py): sync.py takes the exact second from here and the race clock from the FIT rides. A rider is named only where the FIT track and the picture agree; elsewhere (several riders in red helmets on black bikes) no caption claims who is on screen.

IMG_5363.MOV.what: Morning roll-out on the flat (10:21): a red-helmet rider rides past on the left

IMG_5364.MOV.what: Roll-out on farm roads: the group strung out ahead, the filmer's shadow on the fence

IMG_7771.MOV.what: Caimari village: the group rolls through between yellow houses and green shutters, passing the camera

IMG_7772.MOV.what: Leaving Caimari: the crossed-out town sign, the climb begins

IMG_7774.MOV.what: The gorge: riders on a hairpin under rock walls, the camera rides through them

IMG_7778.MOV.what: Roadside under olive trees: four riders come up the road and pass close

IMG_7782.MOV.what: The stone-wall balcony: riding up the line of riders, mountains and big clouds behind

IMG_7786.MOV.what: On the wheel of a red-helmet rider, close

IMG_7787.MOV.what: Roadside: a pair climbs out of the valley road; El Halcon (red helmet) passes in profile, alone in front after his attack (FIT: the only one of the seven within 150 m)

IMG_7789.MOV.what: Roadside under pines: a red-helmet rider comes through, a car behind the riders

IMG_7792.MOV.what: The last hairpin below the col: El Szczupak rises out of it, passes, rides to the top

IMG_7793.MOV.what: The last hairpin: a passer-by waves, then Krzys climbs out of the bend and passes with a grin

IMG_7794.MOV.what: The last hairpin: El Lobo crosses it, passes, a whip pan, the COLL DE SA BATALLA 576 m sign

IMG_7795.MOV.what: The last two: Rafi, then Karol two seconds behind, to the summit sign (FIT: Rafi was 22 m ahead on the road; Karol's official time is still 3 s faster, he started 6 s later)
